steps.title: Why Performance Matters
steps.text: Surgewave targets 1M+ messages per second per broker with sub-millisecond P50 latency and a GC-free hot path. Understanding throughput, latency, and memory efficiency is key.

steps.title: Optimization Pipeline
steps.text: Follow a four-step cycle: measure baseline performance, profile to find hotspots, apply targeted optimizations, then validate improvements with re-benchmarking.

steps.title: Key Performance Settings
steps.text: Tune BatchSize for throughput, LingerMs for latency vs throughput trade-off, CompressionType for CPU vs network, and Acks for durability vs speed.

steps.title: Surgewave vs Kafka Performance
steps.text: Surgewave achieves 10x throughput improvement, 2-5x better P50 latency, 100% reduction in per-message memory, and 10-50x fewer GC pauses compared to Kafka.

steps.title: Best Practices
steps.text: Always measure before optimizing. Batch operations, pool buffers, use Span<T> to avoid copies, never block on async, size partitions for parallelism, and monitor P99 in production.
